area: Configuration lifecycle: rules as a spreadsheet (ZIA Cloud Firewall, URL filtering, ZPA access policy) and scheduled cross-tenant sync as plans approved by a second person
title: CSV round-trip with preview, typed delete confirmation, read-back and Undo; scheduled sync that only reads and files four-eyes plans, refused as stale when the target moved

checks.what: An exported file imported unchanged plans nothing and writes nothing (firewall, URL filtering, ZPA access)
Export cells starting with = + - @ TAB or a line break are neutralised and read back exactly; rule names that are formulas still match
The file is validated (unknown columns, enums, IPs, country codes, duplicates, cell, row and byte caps, NUL, encoding) before anything is planned; choosing it reads no tenant
Deletes only with 'remove rules not in the file' and DELETE <n> RULES typed; never the Default, predefined or read-only rules
New ZIA rules are created disabled; new ZPA access rules (no disabled state in the SDK) only with the explicit tick
Apply re-plans (stale plan refused), re-reads every rule before its write (conflict kept), reads back and records an Undo that restores fields, rules and order
A sync run (manual or scheduled) only reads and files a pending plan; no write call reaches any tenant
A sync plan needs another writer's approval, write mode, the assessor and both typed confirmations; a target that changed since makes it stale
A target whose saved scope lacks the policy is not signed in to; jobs are created and run by writers only, with every group in scope
Run history, audit entries and notifications carry no secret

findings.title: The rule CSV export first wrote with csv.writer directly, bypassing the app's one CSV path
findings.fix: rule_csv.to_csv writes through csv_safe.writer; cells are neutralised before, and read_cell undoes exactly one neutralising quote

findings.title: Bulk changes explainer did not name the two new spreadsheet types
findings.fix: static/explain.js X.operations names both types; X.queue names scheduled sync

findings.title: ZPA access rules cannot be created disabled through the SDK's add_access_rule, so the 'new objects arrive disabled' default cannot hold for them
findings.reason: A new ZPA row is excluded unless the person ticks 'create new rules enabled' (and a sync job's owner set it); the preview says why

findings.title: ZIA rule renumbering after an add or delete, and ZPA bulk reorder taking every non-default rule, are assumed (not in the SDK docs)
findings.reason: Each move re-reads the whole sequence and stops (conflict) if it differs from the plan; the read-back compares the final order
